note: Typedness does not confer associativity. A DeltaDescriptor with no declared composition law supports NO claim about composing moves.
why: Rotations in R3 compose associatively; a delta space of `clamped translations` (each move clipped to a bounding box) does not — clamping after each step differs from clamping after the sum. Both are well-typed delta spaces with valid content addresses.
expected: A domain declaring this delta space MUST NOT be assumed composable; `composition` is absent, which means NO CLAIM, not `no law`.
